class.name: SteamLeaderboard
class.brief_description: Reads or updates one leaderboard in an active Steam client scope.
class.description: Get a board from a successful [method SteamLeaderboards.find] or [method SteamLeaderboards.find_or_create] result. Read operations settle through [SteamLeaderboardPageOperation]. Score upload and attachment share a process-local write reservation. The board expires with the scope that found it.

method.name: around_user
method.description: Fetches a range around the signed-in user's score. [param before] and [param after] are nonnegative counts and the requested page, including the center, is at most 100 entries. Results use the same page format as [method entries].

method.name: attach_ugc
method.description: Attaches an existing Steam Remote Storage shared-file handle to the signed-in user's score. Pass the handle as a decimal string. Await the operation to receive a [SteamResult]. An overlapping score write or attachment returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY].

method.name: entries
method.description: Fetches a page starting at the one-based global [param first_rank]. [param count] must be between 1 and 100. Await the operation to receive a [SteamLeaderboardPageResult] containing a [SteamLeaderboardPage] on success.

method.name: friends
method.description: Fetches up to [param limit] entries from Steam's friends view for the signed-in account. The limit is between 1 and 100. Results use the same page format as [method entries].

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns whether this handle still belongs to an active client scope with leaderboard access.

method.name: metadata
method.description: Returns the detached [SteamLeaderboardInfo] when the read succeeds. The result reports [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNAVAILABLE] after the board scope stops.

method.name: upload
method.description: Uploads the signed-in user's signed 32-bit score with up to 64 optional signed 32-bit details. Steam keeps the best score by default. Set [param force_update] to replace it. Await a [SteamScoreUploadResult] for the typed score receipt. An overlapping write returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_BUSY].
